01 — unknown sky

Unknown Sky

“Out of every possible world, every possible sky, somehow — I found you.”

I used to feel so lost somehow,
Not knowing where I’m going now.
I looked at stars up in the sky,
And wondered where I fit, and why.

The world felt big, the road felt long,
Sometimes I felt like I didn’t belong.
I was just drifting, like a star,
Not knowing where I was or where you are.

Then I found you, and somehow things changed,
The way I saw the world rearranged.
Nothing became perfect overnight,
But somehow, you made things feel right.

When I’m with you, I don’t feel lost,
Even when life gets hard and crossed.
You make this crazy world feel small,
Like I don’t have to figure out it all.

If I were a planet floating alone,
You’d be the place that feels like home.
If I were a star afraid to shine,
You’d be the reason I still try.

There are billions of stars in the sky,
And countless worlds that pass us by.
But out of everything this universe could do,
I’m just grateful that it led me to you.

And maybe one day our stars will fade,
And the little worlds we built will change.
But wherever this universe takes me to,
I hope I’ll always find my way back to you.

Because I was lost before I knew,
That home could be a person too.
And in this endless universe so wide,
You’re the one I want beside my side.

01 — our memories

Small moments.
Infinite meaning.

We don't need a perfect universe. I just want more ordinary days that become extraordinary because I'm spending them with you.

“Maybe the universe is infinite,
but my favorite place is still beside you.”
03 — our orbit
If I could choose
a place in every universe,
I would still choose
you.
04 — a little letter

To my favorite person.

In a world with billions of people, countless places, and skies that never end, somehow our paths crossed.

I don't know what the future looks like, and maybe we don't need to. I just hope it has more sunsets, more stupid pictures, more laughter, more places we've never seen, and more moments where we look at each other and think, “I'm glad you're here.”

If the world is a universe of its own, then you are the part of mine that makes it feel like home.
